## CookieExpiryInfo.expiresAt property

The final expiry time derived from the above (ISO-8601 UTC). For `Max-Age` cookies this is computed against [CookieExpiryInfo.storedAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.storedat.md) (or [CookieExpiryInfo.parsedAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.parsedat.md) if the cookie was never stored). `null` for session cookies and for values outside the representable `Date` range. A `Max-Age` of zero or less yields the epoch (`1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`<!-- -->), mirroring [Cookie.expiryDate()](./tough-cookie.cookie.expirydate.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
expiresAt: string | null;
```
